title: IPO bid upload (NSE eIPO) - PROVISIONAL layout
when: Each bidding day, during bidding hours
purpose: Bulk upload of client bids (new, modify, cancel) for a public issue on NSE's eIPO platform, one line per bid option. eIPO takes up to 1,00,000 lines a file and returns a success file and an error file. PROVISIONAL: correct the columns from eIPO (Misc > File Format) before the first live upload.

columns.name: activityType
columns.note: N new, M modify, C cancel

columns.name: symbol
columns.note: issue symbol on the platform

columns.name: category
columns.note: the platform's category code (set per issue in Ledgerline)

columns.name: subCategory
columns.note: the platform's sub-category code, if the issue has one

columns.name: applicationNumber
columns.note: the platform's application number; blank for a new bid

columns.name: referenceNumber
columns.note: the member's own reference: Ledgerline's bid number

columns.name: pan
columns.note: first holder's PAN

columns.name: depository
columns.note: NSDL or CDSL

columns.name: dpId
columns.note: DP ID: IN and 6 digits for NSDL, 8 digits for CDSL

columns.name: clientBenId
columns.note: beneficiary (client) ID, 8 digits

columns.name: upiFlag
columns.note: Y for a UPI bid, N for ASBA through the client's bank account

columns.name: upi
columns.note: the client's own UPI ID (UPI bids)

columns.name: bankName
columns.note: the client's SCSB (ASBA bids above Rs 5 lakh, or non-individuals)

columns.name: bankAccount
columns.note: the client's own bank account (ASBA bids)

columns.name: bidId
columns.note: bid option 1 to 3

columns.name: quantity
columns.note: shares (or NCD units) in this option

columns.name: atCutOff
columns.note: Y or N

columns.name: price
columns.note: bid price; the cap price for a cut-off bid

columns.name: amount
columns.note: quantity x price, less any discount

columns.name: series
columns.note: NCD series; blank otherwise

columns.name: clientCode
columns.note: the client's UCC with the member

linked: Written from IPO & public issues (Bids: bid file), one file per issue and exchange
source: PROVISIONAL. The standardised trading-member bulk upload and response layouts are in NSE circular NSE/IPO/58442 of 18 Sep 2023, Annexure 2 (https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/IPO58442.pdf), and on eIPO under Misc > File Format; neither was publicly retrievable. These field names follow NSE's eIPO bid API as relayed in public broker documentation (symbol, category, clientName, depository, dpId, clientBenId, pan, referenceNumber, upiFlag, upi, bids: quantity, atCutOff, price, amount). Replace the columns with the eIPO layout before the first live upload.
